import random

seed = int(input())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 7)
s = rng.randint(1, n)
t = rng.randint(1, n)
p = rng.choice([0.2, 0.35, 0.5])
edges = [(u, v) for u in range(1, n + 1) for v in range(1, n + 1) if u != v and rng.random() < p]
rng.shuffle(edges)
print(n, len(edges), s, t)
for u, v in edges:
    print(u, v)
